item.title: How to prove you wrote it — not an AI
item.description: Detection tools are wrong often enough that an AI-use accusation regularly lands on honest writers. The fix is not a better detector. The fix is going to the opposite end of the problem: hold a verifiable date of record showing the draft existed before the accusation could possibly have been made...
